name: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-elibrary

tools.name: gsa_schedule_search
tools.description: Search GSA eLibrary by keyword, SIN number, NAICS code, or contractor/manufacturer name. Returns matching Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) categories/SINs and contractor matches with contract numbers — the starting point for finding who holds a GSA schedule contract.

keyword.description: Keyword, SIN/category number, NAICS code, contract number, or contractor/manufacturer name

search_type.description: How to match multi-word keywords (default all_words)

tools.name: gsa_schedule_contract_holders
tools.description: List Multiple Award Schedule contract holders for a given SIN (Special Item Number), optionally narrowed by a keyword matched against contractor name, contract number, city, or state. Returns each holder's contract number, phone, and location. Use gsa_schedule_search first to find a valid schedule/SIN pair.

schedule.description: Schedule/GWAC number the SIN belongs to (default "MAS")

keyword.description: Optional filter against contractor name, contract number, city, or state

tools.name: gsa_contractor_profile
tools.description: Look up which GSA Multiple Award Schedule(s)/GWAC(s) a contractor holds and its contract number(s) on each. Pass a known `sin` (and `schedule`) to also pull phone/city/state from that SIN's contract-holder listing. Address, email, website, SAM UEI, NAICS, socio-economic/exclusion-list status, and option-period end date are not available from this tool — eLibrary's per-contract detail page that carries them is blocked from our network; the response names this plainly.

contractor_name.description: Contractor/manufacturer name (matched case-insensitively against eLibrary's search results)

contract_number.description: Optional — narrow to one specific contract number when the contractor holds several

sin.description: Optional — a Special Item Number already known to be held by this contractor (e.g. from gsa_schedule_search), used to additionally pull phone/city/state

schedule.description: Schedule/GWAC number the `sin` belongs to (default "MAS"); only used when `sin` is given

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gsa-elibrary forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gsa-elibrary pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
